critical_code_review_comments: Trust.jsx is 380+ lines but structurally clean (mostly data + JSX); acceptable, no split needed.
The `x-file-name`/`x-line-number` HMR attributes appear in H1 inner_html — this is dev-mode instrumentation, harmless in prod build.
Footer 'Made-in-UAE' link uses <Link to='/trust'> which is semantically fine; consider adding aria-label for the SVG flag icon for a11y polish (currently only aria-hidden), non-blocking.
test_credentials: n/a — /trust and content sweep are public routes, no auth required.
